featured_reviews.review_text: My 7-year-old son has been learning Piano at The Musician's Atelier with Mayank Arya, and we are extremely happy with the experience. He patiently teaches basics like hand positioning, rhythm, notes, and overall musical understanding in a very engaging way for kids. We’ve seen a noticeable improvement in our son’s confidence, discipline, and interest in music. Highly recommended for anyone looking for structured and quality piano learning for children!

featured_reviews.review_text: I've been taking piano lessons here for 7 months now and this is the first time I have been taking in-person lessons. featured_reviews.name: Shrikant Juneja
featured_reviews.review_text: I’ve been learning music with Mayank for almost 2 years now, and I can honestly say it’s been such a great experience. Whether it’s theory or technique, he makes sure you actually get it rather than just memorizing things. You can tell he genuinely loves teaching and cares about his students’ progress. Highly recommend him to anyone looking to build a strong foundation in music or take their skills to the next level!

I am back here to continue with my review. I enrolled here to learn saxophone as I mentioned earlier, however, now I can play saxophone, Ukulele, harmonica and most of all I recorded my 3 songs here. featured_reviews.name: Shawn Colaco
featured_reviews.review_text:
I enrolled with genuine interest in learning music, but my experience here was extremely disappointing and a complete waste of money.
The teaching lacks structure and consistency, with little to no personalised attention. You simply attend the sessions, but don’t actually learn much or see any meaningful progress.
The overall approach feels purely commercial, more focused on collecting fees than nurturing students or musical growth. For anyone even mildly serious about music, this setup is frustrating and demotivating.
What’s also concerning is that students are actively encouraged to write reviews, which makes many of the glowing ratings feel forced rather than organic. Based on my experience, the reality does not match the online hype.
I regret enrolling and would not recommend this academy to anyone looking for quality music education.

Atrium has been a wonderful platform for me to start my music path. Although I am starting quite late in life , I always wanted to challenge myself with learning classical Hindustani  music.
Bhoomika Joshi ma’am has been just wonderful in this. She’s supportive , kind and a brilliant singer herself. Her techniques and teaching method has really made this learning journey super smooth. Thank you Maam and thank you Artium Academy!

featured_reviews.name: Vidya Chandrasekhar
featured_reviews.review_text:
My daughter has been learning from Lakshmi Priya ma’am and she is one of the most patient, kind and melodious teachers. Thank you ma’am.

We had to re register for the next course and Akshay Subash, the Lead with the support team was again extremely patient, kind and supportive. In spite of my erratic schedules and multiple postponement, he worked through the process and helped me book more classes. Thank you, Akshay.

featured_reviews.name: Suchitra Alipuria
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am truly grateful to be a part of this amazing platform. I have been learning under the guidance of Ms. Jyoti Debnath, who is not only an exceptionally talented singer but also a highly knowledgeable and inspiring teacher. She constantly encourages me to take on even the most challenging songs and always expresses confidence in my abilities, which motivates me greatly.
I thoroughly enjoy her classes and appreciate the dedication and passion she brings to teaching. Artium Academy has filled my life with music and provided me with numerous opportunities to participate in shows and performances, each of which has been a valuable learning experience.
I would like to sincerely thank Jyoti Ji and Artium Academy for investing their time, effort, and belief in me.

featured_reviews.name: Dr. Kuhu Chatterjee
featured_reviews.review_text:
Great set up....extremely approachable teacher and support team....vey very well planned class structure with assignments that ensure that we practice....the web platform has everything....even a digital piano where we can clearly see what the teacher plays and the teacher can see us.....they provide class recordings and access to study materials as well....so that we can keep going back and revising whenever we want.......
Flexible class schedule, group performances, interaction with experts, you name it and it's there.....classes are suitable for all age groups....they even guide us through international certification exams.....loved everything and hope to keep learning

featured_reviews.name: Bhavya Saxena
featured_reviews.review_text: "I've had a wonderful experience at this music academy. The instructors are knowledgeable, patient, and supportive, making learning both enjoyable and effective. The classes are well-structured, and I've noticed a significant improvement in my vocal technique, confidence, and overall singing ability. The environment is encouraging and welcoming, which makes every session something to look forward to. I would highly recommend this academy to anyone interested in developing their singing skills, whether they're a beginner or an experienced vocalist."

featured_reviews.name: Mukta Chaudhary
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had scheduled a demo class for my child 2–3 days in advance, but the academy did not turn up as planned. Till the last minute, they kept sending invites and reminders—even though their teacher never showed up. To attend this class, I had rescheduled all of my child’s other classes and even adjusted my office timings. This was especially disappointing as it was for a small child, and I expected the academy to value our time and the child’s interest. Clear communication and reliability are crucial, especially when
working with young children. I hope the academy takes this feedback seriously and improves their scheduling and commitment.

featured_reviews.name: Amita Jaggi
featured_reviews.review_text:
I'm a bit disappointed with our experience at Artium. My daughter has been taking online classes, but there are a few ongoing issues. Sometimes the internet on the teacher's side doesn't work properly, and classes often end 5 to 7 minutes early. On top of that, another 5 to 7 minutes are spent just booking the next slot. While scheduling is understandable, losing a significant chunk of class time each session—especially with the high fees—is frustrating.

Over 10 sessions, we’ve lost nearly an entire class's worth of time. It really feels like there’s no accountability for ensuring the full class time is used.

My daughter even asked me not to mention any teacher's name, worrying it might affect them. But this is a broader issue—one that the team should be monitoring. Are all students getting the full hour they’re paying for?

I’ve attached screenshots as proof. Sadly, I won't be enrolling my daughter again. I feel in-person learning will be more effective and reliable.

featured_reviews.name: Rajvi Kapadia
featured_reviews.review_text:
I purchased the Platinum singing class package from Atrium Academy and paid the full amount upfront at the end of January. As part of the package, we were promised a music studio kit delivered to our address, but it still hasn’t arrived.
Since then, I have had to chase this issue 5–6 times. Each time I was told there had been a problem with the order, that it had been cancelled and reordered, and that the matter had been escalated with someone expected to contact me within 48 hours. In most cases, I did not receive the follow-up that was promised.
On one occasion, someone contacted me to check whether the kit had been delivered. When I confirmed it had not, I was told it appeared to be a system glitch and that the order had actually been cancelled. After numerous attempts and speaking to different teams, I was finally given a point of contact who genuinely tried her best to help and even attempted to support while she was on medical leave. But again, no further follow-up as promised.
I have now been informed that Amazon has cancelled the order for the fourth time. Overall, I am highly disappointed with the level of service. The academy requires full upfront payment but has still not delivered a key part of the package, despite repeated chasing from my side.
